title: 第657章 血巫黑市第656章 割喉酒馆
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: 出乎修斯意料的是，这酒馆的酒保反而不是血巫，而是一位经过了生物改造的巫师。
他的双臂已经不见了踪影，取而代之的是八条取自深海章鱼的触手。
“啪叽、啪叽啪叽——”
蓝紫色的触手上布满吸盘，边缘还泛着淡淡的幽蓝荧光，它们每一次收缩都带着黏腻的水声，却不显笨拙。
此刻，两根触手正精准捏住酒瓶的瓶颈，吸盘贴着瓶壁旋转，将瓶身擦得锃亮。
同一时刻，三根触手正飞速摆弄着木质酒杯，将它们一一放在客人面前。
至于剩下的触手，则麻利地整理着酒架上的各类烈酒，将歪倒的酒瓶一一归位。
“哐哐！
哗啦……吨吨吨——”
八根触手快得只剩残影，清脆的碰撞声、与“吨吨”
的倒酒声交织在一起，成了酒馆里唯一的声音。
它们就这样各司其职，在巫师背后的酒架以及前面的吧台间灵活翻飞，仿佛各自都拥有独立的意识。
修斯观摩了一会儿，随即走了过去……
“哦？陌生的精神力波动，看来是新面孔啊。”
而见一位佩戴鸟嘴面具的巫师走近，那位忙碌中的八手酒保也抬头打量起了对方。
“需要什么？这是酒单，你可以看一看。”
说着，他便空出了一条触手，将一张泛黄的羊皮纸推了过来。
修斯扫了眼，随即沉声道：
“我要一杯——碎颅血酿。”
这便是酒馆的暗语，点这种酒，便代表着要进入酒馆里的隐秘交易点，也就是黑市。
“哦？好的，请稍等。”
闻言，酒保脸色不变，随即立刻开始为修斯调配起了酒水。
只见那八根触手齐齐一滞，随即立刻停下了当前的工作，竟是要一起调配这杯特殊的酒。
只见其中最粗壮的两根触手径直探入了最深处的暗格，随即从里面猛地抽出了一只暗红色的酒坛。
坛身刻着一道道扭曲的纹路，表面隐隐传来股诡异的阴冷气息。
而其余触手则在吧台下灵活翻找，有的取出一只血红色的膏，有的则卷出了一撮灰白色的碎末……
而待将所有材料加入调酒杯后，一条触手便取来一只木勺，探入酒坛深处，舀出了满满一勺的浓稠血浆。
没错，血浆。
那坛子中封存的，竟是由诸多种族血混杂而成的血浆！
“呵呵……不用害怕，这是经过血能特殊处理过的，严格意义上来说已经不算血液了。”
那酒保阴笑道，随即将那满满一勺的血浆倒入调酒杯里，与其他材料混合。
“最重要的是——没有腥味。”
说罢，两根触手便已缠住了调酒杯……
待调配完后，一条触手便夹出了一只嵌着血石的银制高脚酒杯。
“吨吨吨——”
在触手的操控下，调酒杯微微倾斜，将里面醇厚的猩红酒液缓缓倒入杯中。
待酒杯灌满，酒保便将其推至了修斯面前。
“请慢用，还有你需要支付一百魔石。”
content_en:
To Hughes's surprise, the bartender in this tavern was not a blood witch, but a biologically modified wizard.
His arms were gone, replaced by eight tentacles taken from deep-sea octopuses.
"Pah, pah, pah, pah—"
The blue-purple tentacles are covered with suction cups, and there is a faint blue fluorescence on the edges. Every time they contract, they make a sticky sound, but they don't look clumsy.
At this moment, the two tentacles are precisely pinching the neck of the wine bottle, and the suction cup rotates against the bottle wall, polishing the bottle body.
At the same moment, three tentacles were rapidly fiddling with wooden wine glasses and placing them one by one in front of the guests.
As for the remaining tentacles, they quickly sorted the various spirits on the wine rack and returned the tilted bottles one by one.
"Bang!
Wow... tons, tons, tons—"
The eight tentacles were so fast that only afterimages were left, with crisp collision sounds and "tons and tons"
The sound of pouring wine was intertwined and became the only sound in the tavern.
They just perform their duties, flying flexibly between the wine rack behind the wizard and the bar in front, as if they each have an independent consciousness.
Hughes watched for a while, then walked over...
"Oh? Unfamiliar mental power fluctuations, it seems like a new face."
Seeing a wizard wearing a beak mask approaching, the busy bartender with eight hands also raised his head and looked at him.
"What do you need? Here's the wine list, you can take a look."
As he spoke, he freed up a tentacle and pushed a piece of yellowed parchment over.
"Shua——"
Hughes glanced at it and then said in a deep voice:
"I want a glass of skull-crushing blood brew."
This is the code word of the tavern. Ordering this kind of wine means entering the secret trading point in the tavern, which is the black market.
"Oh? Okay, please wait."
Hearing this, the bartender's expression did not change, and he immediately started mixing drinks for Hughes.
The eight tentacles were all stagnant, and then they immediately stopped their current work to prepare this special glass of wine together.
I saw the two thickest tentacles directly reaching into the deepest secret compartment, and then suddenly pulled out a dark red wine jar from inside.
The body of the altar is engraved with twisted lines, and a strange cold aura is faintly coming from the surface.
The other tentacles rummaged flexibly under the bar, some took out a blood-red ointment, and some rolled out a handful of gray-white powder...
After all the ingredients were added to the mixing glass, a tentacle took a wooden spoon, reached into the depths of the wine jar, and scooped out a spoonful of thick plasma.
That’s right, plasma.
What was sealed in that jar was actually plasma mixed with the blood of many races!
"Haha... don't be afraid. This has been specially treated with blood energy. Strictly speaking, it is no longer blood."
The bartender smiled sinisterly, then poured a spoonful of plasma into the mixing glass and mixed it with other ingredients.
"The most important thing is - no fishy smell."
After that, two tentacles wrapped around the mixing glass...
"..."
After the mixing was completed, a tentacle took out a silver goblet embedded with bloodstone.
"Tons, tons, tons——"
Under the control of the tentacles, the mixing glass was slightly tilted, and the mellow scarlet wine inside was slowly poured into the glass.
"Creak?——"
When the wine glass was filled, the bartender pushed it in front of Hughes.
"Please use it slowly, and you need to pay one hundred magic stones."
